fichas.title: Flat Roofs
fichas.summary: Flat roofs are defined by slopes up to 5%, with a generally recommended minimum slope of 2% and a recommended constructed minimum of 5% (3°) to account for construction tolerances and deflection. The page compares planar and linear structural systems and describes slabs, trusses, beam grillages, and space frames, with illustrated construction examples.
uses: Transferring roof loads through planar or linear structural systems
